# Script to produce the karyoplots figures which indicate the extent of the neo-sex fusion based on the mapping of the reference autosomal chromosome

## 1. Configuration and data set-up
```{r}

#load libraries
library(readxl)
library(IRanges)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(karyoploteR)
library(png)

#re-start graphics
graphics.off()

# Working directory
setwd("C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3")
# chicken centromeres data
chicken_centromeres <- read_excel("C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3/Results.xlsx", sheet = "Chicken centromere")
names(chicken_centromeres) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End")
chicken_centromeres$Start <- chicken_centromeres$Start + 1
centromeres.gr <- GRanges(
  chicken_centromeres$Chr,
  IRanges(chicken_centromeres$Start, chicken_centromeres$End)
)

# chicken genome indexed file
fai_file <- "GCA_024206055.1_ASM2420605v1_genomic_renamed.fna.fai"
chr_table <- read.table(fai_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(chr_table) <- c("Chr", "Length", "Offset", "BasesPerLine", "LineWidth")
chr_numbers <- sub(".*_chromosome_([0-9A-Za-z]+)$", "\\1", chr_table$Chr)
chr_table$Chr <- paste0("chr", chr_numbers)

genome_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = chr_table$Chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = 1, end = chr_table$Length)
)

all_chrs <- seqlevels(genome_gr)
autosome_chrs <- all_chrs[!(all_chrs %in% c("chrW", "chrZ"))]

# fission coordinates data
fission_pos <- read_excel("C:/Users/Julia/Desktop/IRT3/Results.xlsx", sheet = "Fission coordinates")
names(fission_pos) <- c("Species", "Scaffold", "Chr", "Start", "End", "Length")
fission.gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = fission_pos$Chr,
  ranges = IRanges(fission_pos$Start, fission_pos$End),
  Species = fission_pos$Species
)


```


## 2. Plotting
```{r}

# DEFINE CUSTOM CHROMOSOME COLORS HERE
# Specify colors using names (e.g., "blue"), hex codes (e.g., "#FF5733"), etc.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
custom_chr_colors <- c(
  "chr6" = "darkcyan",
  "chr8" = "olivedrab3",
  "chr22" = "goldenrod2",
  "chr23" = "maroon",
  "chr28" = "chocolate4"
  # Add more chromosomes and colors as needed:
  # "chr7" = "gold",
  # "chr8" = "pink"
)

default_palette <- setNames(
  rainbow(length(autosome_chrs), s = 0.75, v = 0.85),
  autosome_chrs
)

chr_color_palette <- default_palette
# Override default palette with custom user colors where provided
matching_custom <- intersect(names(custom_chr_colors), names(chr_color_palette))
chr_color_palette[matching_custom] <- custom_chr_colors[matching_custom]


#subset of species to plot 
SPECIES_TO_PLOT <- c("Cal_nic", "Acr_tri", "Pte_gut", "Lep_dis", "Pla_leu", "The_cae")
# SPECIES_TO_PLOT <- NULL   # <- uncomment this line instead to plot ALL species


species_list <- unique(fission_pos$Species)
species_list <- species_list[!is.na(species_list) & species_list != ""]

if (!is.null(SPECIES_TO_PLOT)) {
  missing_requested <- setdiff(SPECIES_TO_PLOT, species_list)
  if (length(missing_requested) > 0) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "These SPECIES_TO_PLOT values were not found in fission_pos$Species and will be skipped: %s",
      paste(missing_requested, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  species_list <- species_list[species_list %in% SPECIES_TO_PLOT]
}

species_info <- data.frame(
  Species = species_list,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
species_info$Chr <- sapply(species_info$Species, function(sp) {
  as.character(seqnames(fission.gr[fission.gr$Species == sp])[1])
})
species_info$Length <- chr_table$Length[match(species_info$Chr, chr_table$Chr)]

missing_info <- species_info[is.na(species_info$Chr) | is.na(species_info$Length), ]
if (nrow(missing_info) > 0) {
  print(missing_info)
  stop("Some species have no matching chromosome/length -- see rows above.")
}

#order figure so that larger chromosome appears on top.
species_info <- species_info[order(-species_info$Length), ]
n_species <- nrow(species_info)


TARGET_MAX_PANEL_PX_W <- 5000   # widest chromosome in THIS run renders at this width
max_len_mb_this_run <- max(species_info$Length) / 1e6
PX_PER_MB <- TARGET_MAX_PANEL_PX_W / max_len_mb_this_run
cat(sprintf(">>> This run: widest chromosome = %.1f Mb -> PX_PER_MB = %.2f\n",
            max_len_mb_this_run, PX_PER_MB))

PANEL_PX_H  <- 1000   # fixed pixel height per panel (~3.3in at res=300).

PNG_RES     <- 300
MIN_PANEL_PX_W <- 400  # true crash-safety floor now (not the primary scale

panel_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "species_panels")
dir.create(panel_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

panel_files  <- character(n_species)
panel_widths <- integer(n_species)
failed_species <- character(0)

for (i in seq_len(n_species)) {
  sp  <- species_info$Species[i]
  chr <- species_info$Chr[i]
  len_mb <- species_info$Length[i] / 1e6
  
  this_width <- max(round(len_mb * PX_PER_MB), MIN_PANEL_PX_W)
  panel_widths[i] <- this_width
  
  out_path <- file.path(panel_dir, paste0("panel_", i, "_", sp, ".png"))
  panel_files[i] <- out_path
  
  result <- tryCatch({
    png(out_path, width = this_width, height = PANEL_PX_H, res = PNG_RES)
    
    # main = "" removes the species title above the plot
    # labels.plotter = NULL removes the "chr" prefix in front of the ideogram
    kp <- plotKaryotype(
      genome = genome_gr,
      chromosomes = chr,
      main = "",
      cex = 0.7,
      labels.plotter = NULL
    )
    
    this_chr_col <- chr_color_palette[[chr]]
    
    kpPlotRegions(
      kp,
      data = fission.gr[fission.gr$Species == sp],
      data.panel = "ideogram",
      col = this_chr_col,
      border = "black"
    )
    
    kpPlotRegions(
      kp,
      data = centromeres.gr[seqnames(centromeres.gr) == chr],
      data.panel = "ideogram",
      col = "red",
      border = "black"
    )
    
    kpAddBaseNumbers(kp, add.units = TRUE, cex = 0.5)
    
    dev.off()
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (dev.cur() > 1) dev.off()  # make sure the device doesn't stay open on failure
    message(sprintf(
      "FAILED: species='%s' chr='%s' width_px=%d height_px=%d -- %s",
      sp, chr, this_width, PANEL_PX_H, conditionMessage(e)
    ))
    FALSE
  })
  
  if (!isTRUE(result)) {
    failed_species <- c(failed_species, sp)
  }
}

if (length(failed_species) > 0) {
  cat("\n>>> The following species FAILED to plot and were skipped:\n")
  print(failed_species)
  cat(">>> See the FAILED: messages above for the exact width/error per species.\n")
  cat(">>> Common fix: raise MIN_PANEL_PX_W and/or PANEL_PX_H further.\n\n")
  # Drop failed species from the compositing step below so it doesn't
  # crash on a missing file
  keep <- !(species_info$Species %in% failed_species)
  species_info <- species_info[keep, ]
  panel_files  <- panel_files[keep]
  panel_widths <- panel_widths[keep]
  n_species <- nrow(species_info)
}

canvas_width  <- max(panel_widths)
canvas_height <- PANEL_PX_H * n_species

# Convert pixel-based dimensions to inches for PDF device (using PNG_RES / 300 DPI)
pdf_width_in  <- canvas_width / PNG_RES
pdf_height_in <- canvas_height / PNG_RES

pdf("all_species_karyoplot.pdf", width = pdf_width_in, height = pdf_height_in)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, canvas_width), ylim = c(0, canvas_height), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

for (i in seq_len(n_species)) {
  img <- readPNG(panel_files[i])
  y_top    <- canvas_height - (i - 1) * PANEL_PX_H
  y_bottom <- canvas_height - i * PANEL_PX_H
  # left-aligned at x = 0, width = this panel's true pixel width (Stage 1)
  rasterImage(img, xleft = 0, ybottom = y_bottom, xright = panel_widths[i], ytop = y_top)
}


chrs_in_this_run <- unique(species_info$Chr)
legend_labels <- c(chrs_in_this_run, "Centromere")
legend_colors <- c(chr_color_palette[chrs_in_this_run], "red")

legend(
  x = canvas_width * 0.80, y = canvas_height * 0.99,
  legend = legend_labels,
  fill = legend_colors,
  border = "black",
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1,
  xjust = 0, yjust = 1
)


dev.off()
```
